exposure: Preoperative vaginal cleansing with povidone iodine
Preoperative vaginal cleansing with benzalkonium chloride
finding: Preoperative vaginal cleansing with povidone iodine could reduce postoperative pain, analgesic need and infection parameters compared to benzalkonium chloride or no cleansing.
mod_finding: Preoperative vaginal cleansing with povidone iodine was associated with reduced postoperative pain and lower CRP levels compared to the control group.
